story_theme_en: Mali draws three angles on paper. Angle A is 75 degrees. Angle B is 65 degrees. Angle C is 40 degrees. What is the sum of all three angles? Which angles are acute?
helper_tip: Acute angle < 90. Right angle = 90. Obtuse angle > 90. You can add angles like whole numbers.
hint_th: มุมแหลม < 90° มุมฉาก = 90° มุมป้าน > 90° บวกมุมเหมือนจำนวนเต็ม

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Step 1: Add angles → 75 + 65 + 40 = total | Step 2: Check acute → all three < 90 = all are acute | Step 3: Compare to 90 → 75 is closest to 90 (difference 15)

data.content_en: Step 1: Add angles → 75 + 65 + 40 = total | Step 2: Check acute → all three < 90 = all are acute | Step 3: Compare to 90 → 75 is closest to 90 (difference 15)

steps.label: Step 3: Find angle closest to 90
steps.expression: 75 is 15 from 90 | 65 is 25 from 90 | 40 is 50 from 90

formula.display: 75 is 15 from 90 | 65 is 25 from 90 | 40 is 50 from 90

steps.story_connection: Angle A at 75 degrees is closest to 90 degrees. Difference = 15 degrees

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A triangle has angles of 55, 70, and 55 degrees. What is the sum? Which angles are acute?
visual_blocks.explanation: 55 + 70 + 55 = 180 | All angles < 90 so all are acute angles

data.question: A triangle has angles of 55, 70, and 55 degrees. What is the sum? Which angles are acute?
data.explanation: 55 + 70 + 55 = 180 | All angles < 90 so all are acute angles

worked_examples.solution_en: 30 + 60 + 90 = 180 deg. The 90 deg is a right angle.

common_mistakes: Forgetting that acute angles are less than 90 degrees
Adding angles incorrectly because of carrying
hints: Acute angle = greater than 0 but less than 90 degrees.
75 is |90 - 75| = 15 degrees away from 90, which is the smallest difference.
